Initial source fixtures contained generic ASCII comments incompatible with raw binary serialization; declared scaffolds remove those header comments. Explicit comment preservation/refusal cases remain separate.
A legacy raw Unicode fixture used a literal Omega outside the code page; qualification uses the explicit Unicode wire escape. The failed raw construction is not counted as a typed rejection.
limits: No geometry interpretation, proxy or aggregate/embedded sequence support, authoring, cloning, owner relocation, source-profile conversion, private pointer grammar inference, discarded ACDSDATA preservation or exhaustive DXF legality claim.
Only known qualified standard links/common resources/XData participate in dependency guards; private application dependencies remain unknown.
SourceTags preserves typed values and order, not lexical whitespace/numeric spelling or whole-file bytes.
Opaque-specific preflight preserves stream and existing file state; unrelated legacy writer failures do not acquire a general transactional guarantee.
